role_note: Unlike TAL1 and COL6A2, this is intended to test generalization of a frozen interpretability method. Do not run it until exact published alleles are encoded and reference-validated.

sg1617_target_interval.coordinate_convention: 1-based closed interval reported in the primary paper

enhancer_rna_tss.coordinate_convention: 1-based position reported in the primary paper

guide.name: sg1617
guide.orientation_validation: The published spacer is the reverse complement of the hg38 forward sequence at chr2:60495264-60495283.

published_clone_classes.label: +1bp
published_clone_classes.description: Homozygous one-base insertion; the paper text describes the predominant HSPC edit as insertion of A into the GATA1 motif.

published_clone_classes.label: -13bp
published_clone_classes.description: Homozygous 13-base deletion overlapping the targeted enhancer sequence.

published_clone_classes.label: -15bp
published_clone_classes.description: Homozygous 15-base deletion overlapping the targeted enhancer sequence.

reference_validation.method: UCSC getData sequence API on hg38

blocker.reason: No machine-readable supplementary table provides an unambiguous anchored REF/ALT representation for the +1, -13 or -15 HUDEP-2 alleles.
sources_checked: Primary article text and Europe PMC full-text XML.
BLOOD_BLD-2025-030211-mmc1.pdf: Supplemental Figures 5 and 17 contain image-based alignments, which were not transcribed or inferred under the experiment's provenance rule.
BLOOD_BLD-2025-030211-mmc2.xlsx: Table S1 contains dataset/sample labels and Table S2 contains the guide and PCR primers, but neither contains exact clone allele strings.
GSE292698 series metadata and filelist: processed tracks are labeled +1bp, 13bp and 15bp, but no amplicon allele/CRISPResso table is deposited.
blocker.resolution_required: Obtain exact clone sequences or a machine-readable amplicon allele table from the authors or an archival source, then left-normalize each allele against GRCh38 and increment this manifest version.
blocker.prohibited_shortcut: Do not reconstruct coordinates or allele strings by reading bases from the Sanger/amplicon figures.

model_context.experimental_context: HUDEP-2 and primary CD34-positive erythroid progenitors
model_context.context_mismatch: AlphaGenome's locally available K562 tracks are useful but do not exactly match HUDEP-2 or primary erythroblasts; this must be reported as a limitation.
model_context.interval_rule: Center a supported-length interval so that the E+58 edit, BCL11A promoter and BCL11A transcriptional readout remain inside the output interval.

expected_outputs.region: E+58 enhancer RNA TSS around chr2:60495297

out_of_scope_outputs: HBG1/HBG2 activation and fetal-haemoglobin rescue are trans effects on chromosome 11 and cannot be inferred from the chromosome-2 AlphaGenome input window.
controls: Matched local edits of the same size outside the GATA1 motif, to be frozen only after exact primary alleles are recovered.
Dinucleotide-preserving sequence controls and matched random internal interventions.
sgAAVS is the experimental negative control in primary cells but is not a local cis sequence control for this AlphaGenome window.

sources.supports: Exact target interval and eRNA TSS, clone size classes, GATA1 motif disruption and experimentally observed output directions.
Supplemental methods and image-based Sanger/amplicon alignments; not used to infer allele strings.
Table S1 GEO sample mapping; Table S2 exact sg1617 spacer and genotyping primers.
Downloadable archive containing both primary supplementary files.
Processed ATAC, histone, TF/cohesin, PRO-seq and contact datasets for reference and sg1617-edited cells.
